newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan says NCD issues unrelated to stock market.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan says NCD issues unrelated to stock market.

text.p: Taiwan's central bank said on Wednesday its issue of T$5 billion in 14-day negotiable certificates of deposit on Wednesday had nothing to do with movements in the stock market.
"The NCDs issue was a response to the banking system's loose liquidity," said Lee Sheng-yen, a central bank director.
"It had nothing to do with stock market movements," Lee told reporters after the close of Taiwan's markets.
